intro.text: A Rosharan land that was once part of the Silver Kingdom of Makabakam.
A Makabaki kingdom on a peninsula in southwestern Roshar, known as a centre of fashion.

description.text: Liafor and Yezier set the fashions of Roshar, and their folios are read as far off as the Shattered Plains.
Like many Makabaki peoples, Liaforans are dark brown of eye, with deep brown skin.
Folios bound for the Shattered Plains deliberately showed outdated styles, to push the soldiers there into buying military uniforms, which appalled Adolin when he found out.

Liaforan boots are fine enough that in Tashikk a pair gave away a man claiming to be a poor farmer. Tashikki women talk about Liaforan handicrafts, and Rysn passed time in Thaylen City with a Liaforan word puzzle.

Tashikk lies to Liafor's east, Yezier and Alm to its north and Steen to its southwest, with the Aimian Sea off its northwest coast. A major river flows west from near the city of Berizhet into the Aimian Sea.

In fashion folios, each page shows a few outfits for one kind of reader, such as male Azish civil servants. A page of havahs uses Alethi models, and a page of Thaylen women's fashion follows the nobles of Queen Fen's court.
Liafor's rulers include a prince. It often follows Azir's lead in foreign affairs, eagerly joins any council Azir sits on, and likes to cater the meetings itself.

told.title: Part of Makabakam
told.text: In the age of the Silver Kingdoms, Liafor's lands were part of Makabakam.

told.title: Worth asking
told.text: When the True Desolation began, Dalinar judged Liafor and Yezier the only Makabaki kingdoms steady enough to approach about joining his coalition.

told.title: The lost Soulcaster
told.text: Liafor's royal family kept a Soulcaster that could turn things only into smoke, and whoever used it was locked away, though in comfort. Kaza, the prince's cousin, had trained with it since childhood. Seeking a cure for her condition, she took it on a voyage to the island of Akinah, and it was lost there.
